General.content: Work Packs are the execution unit: Single unit of work = WP-ID + goal + P0–P3 tasks + deps + done-definition + risk band.
Drift is tripwired and escalated: Detect semantic/structural/behavior drift -> auto-correct/log -> P1 stabilize -> P0 if repeated.
Artifact state machine prevents chaos: Every artifact lives in Active / Quarantine / Archive / Trash Candidate; deletion is deferred until proven safe.
Tiering is the universal output contract: Tier A exec summary; Tier B operator actions + overlap; Tier C archival/provenance.
TruthScan produces a safe fix queue: Duplicates + canonical plan + Safe-Auto/Safe-Confirm/Manual actions; 'do-no-harm' checklist always emitted.
Prompt Stack enforces the machine: FAST (delta), STRONG (canon), BUILDER (packs), AUDITOR (proof/closure). No free-form wandering.
Visibility matters: dashboard is the control plane: Heatmaps + drift radar + action queue + scan status + session outcomes.
